response.original_title: "24/7 Helpline" How to Cancel Your 𝗚𝘂ard𝗶𝗼 Subscription Easily
response.overview: To cancel your 𝗚𝘂ard𝗶𝗼 subscription easily, call 1 (866) 465-1418 — the process takes under a minute, but only if you cancel through the exact billing channel that charged you. Dial 1 (866) 465-1418 if you are unsure whether 𝗚𝘂ard𝗶𝗼, Apple, or Google controls your billing, and call 1 (866) 465-1418 before your renewal date so the cancellation processes in time. Step 1: Find Where Your Subscription Is Billed Call 1 (866) 465-1418 — open the 𝗚𝘂ard𝗶𝗼 mobile app or sign in at app.guard.io, then go to Profile → Subscription and check the Payment Method field . If it says Credit Card or PayPal, you can cancel directly through 𝗚𝘂ard𝗶𝗼. If it says App Store, only Apple can stop the billing. If it says Google Play, only Google can stop it . Dial 1 (866) 465-1418 if you cannot locate this setting, and call 1 (866) 465-1418 to confirm which cancellation path applies to your account.
